in_arabic.name: Kayid
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Lord, Master, Ruler
in_arabic.long_meaning: Kayid هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root ‘k-y-d’ meaning ‘to be master, to rule, to have power’. In Islamic tradition, Kayid refers to the supreme ruler, the Lord Almighty, Allah.
